parsed.summary: The proposed patch attempts to address the issue by ensuring the timeout is converted to a string, but it does not directly fix the root cause of the UnicodeDecodeError in the HTTP headers.

issues.description: The patch introduces a fragile approach by conditionally converting the timeout to a string, which may not address the root cause of the UnicodeDecodeError in the HTTP headers. The issue seems to stem from the method name being a Unicode string, which should be handled properly in the requests library.
